```{r functions, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
####################
# Functions        #
####################

plot_DE_sharing_per_celltype <- function(de_table_per_ct, feature_column='feature', pval_column='p.bonferroni', sig_pval=0.05, only_positive=F, only_negative=F, lfc_column='metafc', use_label_dict=T, use_color_dict=T){
  DE_genes_per_ct <- list()
  # get the DE genes for each cell type
  for(cell_type in names(de_table_per_ct)){
    # filter to only include the significant results
    de_table <- de_table_per_ct[[cell_type]][de_table_per_ct[[cell_type]][[pval_column]] <= 0.05, ]
    # filter for only the positive lfc if required
    if(only_positive){
      de_table <- de_table[de_table[[lfc_column]] < 0, ]
    }
    # filter for only the positive lfc if required
    if(only_negative){
      de_table <- de_table[de_table[[lfc_column]] > 0, ]
    }
    # we just care about the gene names
    sig_genes <- NULL
    if (is.null(feature_column)) {
      sig_genes <- rownames(mast)
    }
    else {
      sig_genes <- de_table[[feature_column]]
    }
    # store these for the cell type
    DE_genes_per_ct[[cell_type]] <- sig_genes
  }
  if(use_label_dict){
    names(DE_genes_per_ct) <- rename_labels(names(DE_genes_per_ct))
  }
  queries <- list()
  sets.bar.color <- 'black'
  if(use_color_dict){
    # create df to store the number of each set, so we know how to order
    nrs_df <- NULL
    # add the colors for the cell types
    for(i in 1:length(names(DE_genes_per_ct))){
      cell_type <- names(DE_genes_per_ct)[i]
      # add for the singles in the intersection sizes
      ct_list <- list(
        query = intersects,
        params = list(cell_type),
        color = get_color_coding_dict()[[cell_type]],
        active = T)
      queries[[i]] <- ct_list
      # add for the DF to order the set sizes
      numbers_row <- data.frame(ct=c(cell_type), nr=c(length(DE_genes_per_ct[[cell_type]])), stringsAsFactors = F)
      if(is.null(nrs_df)){
        nrs_df <- numbers_row
      }
      else{
        nrs_df <- rbind(nrs_df, numbers_row)
      }
    }
    # get the order of the sets
    ordered_cts <- nrs_df[order(nrs_df$nr, decreasing = T), 'ct']
    # add the colors for the sets
    sets.bar.color <- unlist(get_color_coding_dict()[ordered_cts])
    upset(fromList(DE_genes_per_ct), order.by = 'freq', nsets = length(DE_genes_per_ct), queries = queries, sets.bar.color=sets.bar.color)
  }
  else {
    upset(fromList(DE_genes_per_ct), order.by = 'freq', nsets = length(DE_genes_per_ct))
  }
  
  #return(DE_genes_per_ct)
}


```

```{r setup_paths, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Main Code        #

dar_output_base_loc <- '/groups/umcg-franke-scrna/tmp04/projects/multiome/ongoing/differential_accessibility/limma_dream/output/topics20_otsu_imputed/'

```

```{r monocyte_dars, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# get location of monocyte DARs
dar_monocyte_base_loc <- paste(dar_output_base_loc, '/', 'monocyte', '/', sep = '')

# we will look at these topics
topics <- paste('Topic', 1:20, sep = '')

# we'll store the output of each topic
mono_output_per_topic <- list()

# read each topic
for (topic in topics) {
  mono_output_per_topic[[topic]] <- read.table(paste(dar_monocyte_base_loc, 'monocyte_', topic, '.nominal_significant.tsv.gz', sep = ''), header = T, sep = '\t')
}

plot_DE_sharing_per_celltype(
  mono_output_per_topic,
  use_label_dict = F, 
  use_color_dict = F
)
```
